question: Which of the following diseases has not been prevalent in the country since a few years?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Polio."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the last sentence of the third paragraph:
 
 
• *"Other life-threatening diseases that were prevalent in the country were dengue, typhoid, tuberculosis, and HIV-AIDS."*
 
 
 
• Malaria, Typhoid, and Dengue are all diseases that have been prevalent in the country in recent years.
 
• Polio, on the other hand, has been eradicated in India since 2014.
 
• This is due to a successful vaccination campaign that has been ongoing since the 1990s.
 
• It is important to continue vaccinating children to maintain the eradication of polio in India. 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Malaria is a mosquito-borne disease that is still prevalent in many parts of India.
 
• Typhoid is a bacterial infection that is spread through contaminated food and water.
 
• Dengue is a viral infection that is also spread by mosquitoes.
